description: facebookAdLibrary: Search for Companies. GET /v1/facebook/adLibrary/search/companies. Search Ad Library pages by name and get each page id for /v1/facebook/adLibrary/company/ads, with likes and Instagram details. An empty result costs 0 credits. Costs 1 credit when it succeeds. Costs 0 credits when searchResults is empty. Errors, blocked or timed-out requests, invalid requests and cache hits cost nothing. A not-found or empty result is charged only where that operation's published cost says so.

query.description: Company or page name to search for (up to 200 characters).
